pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregular polygonal patches of reddish-brown pigment. Edges exhibit high-frequency serrations or 'toothed' gradients where the dark regions meet the light inter-patch spaces. Geometric complexity is high, with shapes varying from sub-rectangular on the upper neck to more complex, multi-pointed stars on the shoulder and flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light cream-colored negative space. Pathways are relatively thin but highly continuous, forming a complex graph of predominantly 3-way and 4-way junction nodes. Thickness is mostly uniform with slight narrowing at the vertices between larger neck patches.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the upper neck displays a consistent, low-amplitude serration. It appears as a dense, fuzzy 1D contour of individual hair clusters against the out-of-focus background.
